headline: EPS rises modestly from both prior periods
summary_short: Chailease reported EPS of NT$2.89, up 9.1% y/y from NT$2.65 and up 11.2% q/q from NT$2.60.
summary_long: EPS is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed. Search coverage found first-half 2026 net profit of NT$11,428M but no third-quarter release.
